name: Hindustan Petroleum
about: Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Ltd. (HPCL) is a major player in India’s oil and gas sector, involved in refining, marketing, and distribution of petroleum products. HPCL operates two refineries in Mumbai and Visakhapatnam, with a total refining capacity of 15.8 million metric tonnes per annum. The company supplies a wide range of petroleum products including LPG, petrol, diesel, and lubricants, serving industries, households, and retail customers across India. HPCL also operates an extensive network of retail outlets and LPG distribution centers. It is actively investing in renewable energy and expanding its presence in green fuel and energy-efficient technologies.
